entities.summary: Davis Compton Mills is an American professional football quarterback for the Houston Texans of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Stanford Cardinal and was selected by the Texans in the third round of the 2021 NFL draft. Mills was Houston's starter during his first two seasons, before taking on a backup role after the Texans selected C. J. Stroud.
